question: How to make ai-cache work automatically in Cursor and Claude Code
answer: install.sh auto-installs three layers: (1) skill at ~/.cursor/skills/ai-cache/SKILL.md and ~/.claude/skills/ai-cache/SKILL.md with query-before/save-after instructions, (2) global rules at ~/.cursor/rules/ai-cache.md and ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, (3) Cursor stop hook at ~/.cursor/hooks/auto-cache.sh with loop_limit:1 that fires after each turn reminding the agent to save. All idempotent. No per-project setup needed.
